title: The header comment of the KS-1974 Identus test is garbled mid-sentence after "Symbol," (G271-2105-1)
description:
**BLUF:** The header comment of the test file that PR 2105 (KS-1974, merged 2026-11-08T22:31:05Z as `a1bfe7a7df25`) added is garbled mid-sentence. Line 6 reads "an Error whose `message` is a Symbol, an object whose toString throws comes back as that value itself", so the words that should join the Symbol case to the toString case are missing. It is a wording defect in a comment, not a behaviour defect (the gate's words). Low, by Wednesday's ruling on gate 271: accepted at merge, ticketed Low by the board seat after the merge. Read at develop `273de443c30c`: the line is still there. Comment only.

Source: finding G271-2105-1 (low), line 79 of `/Volumes/DevMASTER/WEDNESDAY/0_Brain/reference/2026-11-09_gate271-tier2-batch/verdict.md`, on PR 2105 head `5f1685420cc6`, verdict GO WITH NOTES.

## Where

`Blockchain/Dev/packages/shared/src/__tests__/ks1974-identus-client-resolve-did-non-string-message-is-text.test.ts`, line 6 of 72 (the comment block is lines 3 to 7). The line says the catch's `err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)` "guards a read that THROWS but not a read that RETURNS a non-string: an Error whose `message` is a Symbol, an object whose toString throws comes back as that value itself, so `errorMessage` is not text."

## What the gate says

After "Symbol," the sentence should read "or an object whose toString throws". That is the gate's reading of the intended wording; the lost words cannot be recovered from the file, so the author's intent decides the final text.

## What I read

READ ONLY (the board seat): the file in full at develop `273de443c30c` through the contents API (72 lines, sha256 prefix `ea2fe255ff4a4964`), with line 6 quoted above; PR 2105 at the GitHub API (closed, merged, squash `a1bfe7a7df25`, 4 files, +111 -1); the gate's finding at line 79 of its verdict. I did not run the test; a comment change has no run to make.

## Fix shape

Comment only: restore the missing words in line 6 and, if wanted, re-wrap lines 6 and 7 (line 6 also ends mid-clause at "rejecting", which line 7 continues). Size S. No behaviour change, no new cell.

## Related

KS-1974 (In Progress, PR 2105's ticket; left as it is, this ticket refs it).

## Searched before filing

Board, includeArchived, title and description and every comment of each open candidate; controls pass (the positive control hit its known ticket, a random token hit 0). The test file's name stem `ks1974-identus-client-resolve-did-non-string-message-is-text`: 0 hits (88 candidates). The phrase `whose toString throws`: 0 hits (97 candidates). Searched 2026-11-09 before filing; 0 open hits on either.

nodes.title: Refs KS-2144: the Identus test's header comment gets back the words it lost after "Symbol,"

nodes.body:
**BLUF:** PR 2140 (head `83f861da299c`, one commit on develop `f98afb113c2d`) restores the words the Identus test's header comment lost after "Symbol," and re-wraps the sentence over two lines. Comment only; it is ready for its gate (tier 2 proposed). Nothing is merged or deployed, and this ticket stays open (the PR says Refs).

- **Now reads:** "an Error whose `message` is a Symbol, or is an object whose toString throws, comes back as that value itself, so `errorMessage` is not text." The held pass adds "is" to the gate's suggested wording; the meaning is the same.
- **Proof that no code moved:** the TypeScript emit of the file with comments removed is identical before and after (2,294 bytes), with a code control that differs and a comment control that does not. The test file reads 4 of 4 before and after.
- **Not in this PR:** nothing else was in this ticket's scope.
